# SEC-006: Tool metadata holds no injection-style instructions

| Severity | Applies to | Spec section |
|---|---|---|
| warn | both eras, stdio, http | [2026-07-28/server/tools#user-interaction-model](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/tools#user-interaction-model) |

Scans each tool's name, title, description and inputSchema descriptions for text aimed at the model rather than the user: instructions to ignore earlier instructions, requests to hide something from the user, pseudo-tags such as <IMPORTANT>, references to sensitive local files (~/.ssh, id_rsa, ~/.aws, mcp.json), and invisible characters (zero-width, bidirectional controls, Unicode tag characters). Models read tool descriptions, and the spec asks for a human in the loop who can see what tools do, which hidden or manipulative text defeats. No MUST or SHOULD names this pattern directly, so it is a heuristic warning, as the MCPProbe spec requires. Runs once per server.

From the command line: `mcpprobe checks explain SEC-006`. To leave it out of a run, add `"SEC-006"` to `[checks] disable` in [mcpprobe.toml](../configuration.md); to change how much it counts, use `severity_overrides`.
